ValidationRule.description: User should not be allowed to save a record if the End Time value is before the Start Time value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(End_Time__c), ISCHANGED(Start_Time__c) ), TIMEVALUE(End_Time__c) <= TIMEVALUE(Start_Time__c), NOT(Bypass_Validation_Rule__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: End Time cannot be prior to Start Time.
